metadata.title: Server Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for Compute and Execution Environments establishing institutional control and accountability for server and workload execution.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Server, workload, and platform execution technology domain.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Physical servers, virtual machines, containers, orchestrated workloads, and serverless execution platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Institutionally managed server execution environments with explicit ownership, boundaries, and management authority.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Server and workload identity records, ownership metadata, execution boundaries, and management state.

props.name: threat-technique
props.remarks: Account manipulation or control of server management mechanisms.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Centralized governance and control of server and workload execution platforms.

metadata.remarks:
Server Core defines the foundational capability that establishes whether an execution environment is a server or workload operated under institutional authority. It defines server identity, execution boundaries, management authority, and baseline trust assumptions. This pattern establishes legitimacy and accountability only; it does not assert integrity, configuration quality, or security posture.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to recognizing and governing servers and workloads as institutional execution environments. All other server patterns assume server-core has been satisfied.

components.title: Server Identity
components.description: Establishment of a unique, authoritative identity for servers and workloads.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Assign and manage identities for servers and workloads.

components.title: Execution Boundaries
components.description: Definition of execution boundaries separating servers and workloads from other execution environments and management planes.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Define and enforce boundaries between server execution environments and other domains.

components.title: Management Authority
components.description: Definition of who or what is authorized to manage, modify, or control servers and workloads.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Restrict and govern changes to servers and workloads through approved management mechanisms.
Ensure server management access is explicitly authorized and tracked.

components.title: Baseline Trust Assumptions
components.description: Minimum trust assumptions that must be satisfied for servers to participate as institutional execution environments.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Allow only essential server functions and prohibit ad-hoc or interactive execution models.
